{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "vicjuma",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Approach ACK; tested RPCs and noted labels help identify cosigners"
    },
    {
      "login": "jeanpablojp",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; raised issues regarding multisig key label support in getaddressinfo, which author resolved"
    },
    {
      "login": "maflcko",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "noted typos in release notes"
    },
    {
      "login": "Eunovo",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; suggested encapsulating m_key_labels inside CWallet, which author implemented"
    },
    {
      "login": "achow101",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "NACK; argued key labels are GUI-only and should not be stored in the wallet DB, and warned against using collidable fingerprints"
    },
    {
      "login": "davidgumberg",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "advocated for persisting key labels to improve signing UX"
    },
    {
      "login": "rkrux",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ~0 tending towards NACK; cited ongoing maintenance burden and unnecessary workflow complexity for RPC key labels"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3896226924",
      "kind": "scope",
      "harm": "getaddressinfo did not return key labels for multisig script addresses",
      "quote": "With both cosigners labelled, getaddressinfo on a wsh(sortedmulti(...)) address returns no key label.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3898091692"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3898091692",
      "settled_by_quote": "Added a per-object key label to getaddressinfo so it takes into account multi-keys scripts."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3912504823",
      "kind": "safety",
      "harm": "making m_key_labels public leaves it exposed to modification and out-of-sync states with the database",
      "quote": "The CWallet class is responsible for keeping it in sync with the DB; making it public leaves it open to modification.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3933169477"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3933169477",
      "settled_by_quote": "done"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5575897296",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "storing key labels in the wallet database is unnecessary because labels were intended only for temporary display during multisig GUI setup",
      "quote": "The key labeling that was discussed is for the GUI only to show friendly names for keys during the multisig setup. Once the setup is complete, the labels would not be shown again, and hence do not need to be stored in the wallet.",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5617385598"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5575897296",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "master key fingerprints are 4 bytes long and prone to collisions, making them unfit as unique identifiers",
      "quote": "DO NOT USE FINGERPRINTS, THEY ARE COLLIDABLE.",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5617385598"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5615886076",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "harm": "incurs ongoing maintenance costs for RPCs that offer little benefit while complicating multisig setup workflows",
      "quote": "I don't see much benefit in providing RPCs for setting or viewing key labels (both separately and within the context of address(es) RPCs).",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5617385598",
        "c:5618498853"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5068635849",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Built the ten commits and ran the new test.",
      "substantive": true
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5079387670",
      "verdict": "Approach ACK",
      "reason": "Approach ACK",
      "substantive": false
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5087710553",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Looks good; left some comments. I also think the new per-key label should be added to the output of gethdkeys.",
      "substantive": true
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5592872052",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "Shouldn't the key labels be persisted so that at signing time the user can see what keys have and haven't signed? I don't see a good reason to not persist key labels when it seems useful for UX.",
      "substantive": true
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Initial record. achow101 and rkrux raised blocking concept objections against storing key labels in the wallet and exposing them via RPC, leading the author to convert the PR to draft; earlier technical feedback from jeanpablojp and Eunovo was resolved."
}

advocated for persisting key labels to improve signing UX
Concept ~0 tending towards NACK; cited ongoing maintenance burden and unnecessary workflow complexity for RPC key labels

claims.harm: making m_key_labels public leaves it exposed to modification and out-of-sync states with the database

claims.quote: The key labeling that was discussed is for the GUI only to show friendly names for keys during the multisig setup. Once the setup is complete, the labels would not be shown again, and hence do not need to be stored in the wallet.

claims.quote: I don't see much benefit in providing RPCs for setting or viewing key labels (both separately and within the context of address(es) RPCs).

support.reason: Built the ten commits and ran the new test.
Looks good; left some comments. I also think the new per-key label should be added to the output of gethdkeys.
